paper_title: Axion Dark Matter Search around 4.55 $μ$eV with Dine-Fischler-Srednicki-Zhitnitskii Sensitivity
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, canonical axion-photon coupling
notes: Paper reports exclusion of axion-photon coupling g_agamma down to 6.2×10^-16 GeV^-1 over mass range 4.51–4.59 μeV at 90% CL, assuming DFSZ axion model with 100% local dark matter density (ρ_a = 0.45 GeV/cm³). This is a measured exclusion limit from haloscope data, not a projection. The mass range is narrow (~80 neV), so encoded as a horizontal line at the stated coupling value. Paper also reports secondary result excluding KSVZ axions at 13% of local DM density (Fig. 5), but primary result is DFSZ coupling shown in Fig. 4. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.92, 41)) | Vision: Exclusion limit plot from FIG. 4 of the paper. The main plot shows the excluded parameter space (blue solid line) at 90% confidence level for axion-photon coupling g_agamma vs axion mass m_a. The boundary traces a V-shaped curve with minimum sensitivity around 4.55 μeV where g_agamma ≈ 6.2×10^-16 GeV^-1 is achieved. The x-axis is linear in mass (4.51–4.59 μeV), and the y-axis is logarithmic in coupling (1e-16 to 1e-14 GeV^-1). The paper assumes 100% local dark matter density (ρ_a = 0.45 GeV/cm³) and DFSZ model parameters (g_s = −0.97). The inset shows comparison with ADMX and other haloscope results.
